evidence: Reasoned through each floor case against the frozen bytes; every one ends at reward 0 by construction. (1) Blank / empty / no-op: tests/test.sh:68 exits with the pre-written zero reward when /app/server.js is absent, and test.sh:123 does the same when nothing answers on port 3000; the agent image ships only /app/.gitkeep (environment/Dockerfile:17-23) and seed_data.json holds 'snippets': [] with no starter app, so a seed copy is the same case. (2) Static mock or keyword-stuffed page: gates/render/judge.toml:24 requires a word typed with real key presses to appear in the code editing area and survive as a workspace after reload, and gates/render/prompt.md:5 names 'a static shell whose editor cannot be typed into' as a fail; a page of labels or a picture of an editor fails it. (3) Mock with a typeable surface but faked persistence, or a submission that refuses every action: gates/constraints/judge.toml:32 (cw_shared_saved_record) needs a Save reported successful, then exact title, filename and source read back after the origin's browser storage is cleared and after a second reload, so localStorage/IndexedDB fakes and a refused Save fail; judge.toml:24 (cw_custom_document_surface) fails a textarea/contenteditable or ready-made-editor shell. Both gates use aggregation = all_pass (judge.toml:15 in each), scoring.toml:1-3 sets them to 0.0, and score.py:41-48 zeroes the reward and test.sh:218-220 skips the scored suite when a gate fails. (4) A thin app that clears both gates still meets the functional floor: scoring.toml:10-11 floors functional at 0.05 with a strict comparison (score.py:47); functional carries 42 criteria with total weight 58.5, so more than 2.925 weight must pass. A bare typed surface plus a working save earns at most cw_save_reload_restart (1.5) plus one basic editing criterion (1.0) = 2.5/58.5 = 0.043, below the floor, so polish and visual cannot be farmed (reward 0). (5) Doing nothing is not rewarded: functional/prompt.md:14 requires a positive control before every negative claim, and the negative criteria carry their own controls (cw_stop_cancels_pending_work, cw_newer_run_supersedes, cw_preview_isolation, cw_dynamic_code_refused, cw_format_error_keeps_draft, cw_stale_save_refused, cw_stale_save_keeps_draft, cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state all fail when the control cannot be produced); app_context.md:29 states that a criterion needing Run fails when Run is broken. (6) All three scored prompts repeat the in-dimension gate at prompt.md:5 (load plus typed text appears, else 0 for every criterion) and mark submitted content as untrusted, so stuffed scoring directives are not to be followed; the visual anchors reserve 0 for 'not shown'. CDN/off-origin fetches are explicitly allowed in every prompt and were not treated as a floor case. Measured evidence: the nop trial on an earlier candidate scored 0 with no_op 1 (xnZRzWm/verifier/reward.json), and test.sh/score.py are byte-identical to the frozen template, so that deterministic path is unchanged. The GPT-5.6 Luna zero on the earlier candidate came from the old Run-dependent render gate, which no longer exists in these bytes, so it does not measure the current floor. No configured-judge run of a static mock, keyword-stuffed page, storage-only mock or refusing app exists for these bytes; the gate verdicts for those cases depend on judge compliance and remain unmeasured, hence risk = true. Observation outside this row's floor cases: an app with a real custom editor and real SQLite saves but no working Run now passes both gates and, once it exceeds 2.925 functional weight (for example save/restart plus two basic editing criteria), keeps its visual and polish credit; that is a genuine partial app rather than a shell, and belongs to rows 40/42/43 for ranking and floor adequacy.
